name: 3 Wildos
review:
The third trip for Thunderkick's bandit gang, this time among pyramids and ruins on five reels and 9 paylines. Multiplier wilds give the base game some punch, and there are three free spins modes, each with its own power-ups.

The bonus brings retriggers and sticky multiplier wilds. High volatility, 5,000x cap. One thing to know: the published RTP is 94.20%, below what most slots pay back on average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
